card.name: Verb after drug name in dementia warning
card.fires_on: The word 'is' or 'are' right after a drug name in the boxed warning sentence '[Drug] is not approved for the treatment of patients with dementia-related psychosis'. It also fires on a few other words that begin a stock label sentence.

modes.label: Drug name then is/are
modes.description: The linking verb after an antipsychotic product name, just before 'not approved for'.
modes.example: Quetiapine fumarate<< is>> not approved for the treatment of patients with

modes.label: Other label sentence openers
modes.description: Short words that open a stock label phrase, such as 'OF' in a heading or 'a' before 'subsidiary'.
modes.example: Pediatric Use:<< Not>> recommended for pediatric use.
